<style>
  /* 按钮容器的布局 */
  .hotZone {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 3500px;
    padding: 20px;
    justify-content: center;
    background: transparent;
  }
  
  /* 单个按钮的悬停动画 */
  .buttonWrapper {
    display: inline-block;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
  }
  
  /* 按钮的主要样式（渐变、描边、圆角等） */
  .customButton {
    padding: 12px 28px;
    border-radius: 50px;
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000000, #2b2b2b, #daa520);
    color: #ffd700;
    font-weight: bold;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: 
      0 0 0 2px #ffd700,
      0 4px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  
  /* 悬停时的效果 */
  .customButton:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 
      0 0 0 2px #ffd700,
      0 8px 20px rgba(218, 165, 32, 0.6);
    background: linear-gradient(to bottom, #000000, #3a3a3a, #ffd700);
  }
  
  /* 点击时的反馈 */
  .customButton:active {
    transform: translateY(1px);
  }
  
  /* 按钮文字样式 */
  .buttonText {
    font-size: 25px;
    text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
  }
  
  /* 按钮的微光动画 */
  .customButton::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: -50%;
    left: -50%;
    width: 200%;
    height: 200%;
    background: linear-gradient(
      to bottom right,
      rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3),
      rgba(255, 215, 0, 0)
    );
    transform: rotate(30deg);
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s;
  }
  
  .customButton:hover::after {
    opacity: 1;
  }
</style>
